targetMilestone.metric: continuous-song strict exact-pitch onset micro-F1 at 100 ms

hypothesis: v004 improved aggregate F1 and recovered part of v003's recall loss when note-on weight increased from 1.00 to 1.15. Raising only note-on token weight to 1.35, which previously helped the direct-piano Phase 94 experiment, may recover enough omitted onsets to pass the frozen recall gate without changing timing, release, data, seed, or optimization.

dataset.role: opened development and model selection; never sealed certification

heldConstant.reasonForSeedReuse: Changing the seed would confound the isolated note-on-weight experiment.

gates: training loss must beat the immutable base on unconditioned validation
the internal decoded unconditioned multi-song panel must pass without recall regression
full 258-clip unconditioned micro-F1 must not regress at 100 ms or 250 ms
no validation song may lose more than 0.005 absolute 100 ms F1
duration, cutoff, overlong-note, frame, and rapid-retrigger limits must pass
the WANE trusted opening must improve after the frozen production-v004 arranger
manual blind listening must confirm cleaner phrasing before any deployment
rejectionPolicy: If any gate fails, preserve a hashed rejection receipt but no model checkpoint; do not deploy, do not advance curriculum, and do not change production routing.
